[EN] It's so refreshing to see a new face. Such a shame it's in our darkest hour. Kind of a mood-killer.

I wish I were going with you. Holding this ground's important, but...bored now.
[ES] Es muy refrescante ver una cara nueva. Qué pena que sea en nuestra hora más oscura. Mata bastante el ambiente.

Ojalá fuera contigo. Mantener este terreno es importante, pero... ya me aburrí.
